# Robinhood Stocks — Tokenized Stocks on Robinhood Chain Reference

> An independent explainer of tokenized stocks on Robinhood Chain — the EVM layer 2 — what on-chain equity tokens are, how they differ from real shares, regional limits and the risks. Not affiliated with Robinhood.

## Key Facts
- Tokenized stock: a blockchain token designed to track a company's share price (an on-chain instrument issued by a provider), generally NOT direct legal share ownership
- Robinhood Chain: described as an EVM-compatible Ethereum layer 2 oriented to tokenized assets; standard wallets connect, gas paid in ETH
- Differences from real shares: voting, dividend treatment and legal claim depend on the issuer's structure; you rely on the issuer and its custody
- Availability varies by jurisdiction — restricted or unavailable in many regions; eligibility is set by the actual provider
- Risks: market + issuer/counterparty risk, smart-contract & custody risk, regulatory uncertainty, price divergence from the underlying, liquidity limits
- Connecting a wallet does NOT grant free stock tokens — such offers are scams
- This page does NOT offer or sell any security; it is informational and NOT investment advice
- Independent resource — NOT affiliated with or endorsed by Robinhood
